name: MSIG Singapore

products.name: Prestige Healthcare
products.subtype: standalone private hospital and surgical plan (Platinum / Deluxe / Elite); page does not describe it as an Integrated Shield Plan
products.summary: Hospitalisation insurance with inpatient and outpatient treatment, overseas cover and optional maternity benefits, aimed partly at expatriates.
facts: Overall maximum annual limit per insured person: Platinum $3,000,000, Deluxe $1,500,000, Elite $900,000
Latest entry age for an adult enrolment is 64 years old (age last birthday), renewable up to age 79
Waiting period: 30 days for hospitalisation for any illness; none for hospitalisation due to accidents
Overseas Medical Evacuation and Repatriation of up to $1 million (Platinum Plan)
The policy does not cover any pre-existing medical conditions
products.evidence: Prestige Healthcare offers tailored solutions for those seeking expat health insurance in Singapore.

products.name: CriticalCare Plus
products.subtype: lump-sum CI (5 conditions) with early-stage cancer and angioplasty accelerated benefits
products.summary: Critical illness plan paying a lump sum for five major illnesses, with accelerated payouts for early-stage cancer and coronary angioplasty.
facts: Basic benefit sum insured: Primary $30,000, Silver $50,000, Gold $75,000, Platinum $100,000
Covers Major Cancer, Heart Attack of Specified Severity, Stroke with Permanent Neurological Deficit, Idiopathic Parkinson's Disease, Alzheimer's Disease / Severe Dementia
Early Stage Cancer: 50% of Sum Insured; Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery: 10% of Sum Insured
Adult aged between 18 years and 60 years old; coverage continues until insured reaches 65 years old at the end of the policy year
Premium is not guaranteed; claims for illnesses first diagnosed within ninety (90) days are not admissible
products.evidence: This critical illness plan covers for five major and common diseases

products.name: CancerCare Plus
products.subtype: standalone cancer plan with early-stage accelerated benefit
products.summary: Standalone cancer-specific plan paying a lump sum for Major Cancer, with an accelerated payout for Early Stage Cancer.
facts: Major Cancer Benefit: $100,000
Early Stage Cancer accelerated benefit: $50,000 (50% of Basic Benefit)
Entry: yourself aged between twenty (20) years and below sixty-five (65) years old, residing in Singapore; renewable up to age 84
Waiting period 90 days; survival period 7 days
The cancer insurance premium is not guaranteed
products.evidence: CancerCare Plus is a standalone cancer-specific insurance plan

products.name: Essential Hospital Income
products.summary: Hospital cash plan paying a daily benefit while hospitalised, doubled in ICU, plus day surgery and get well cash.
facts: Daily hospitalisation cash (up to 365 days per Disability): Classic $150, Silver $250, Premier $400 per day
ICU daily hospitalisation cash (up to 30 days per Disability): $300, $500, $800 per day
Day surgery cash: $150 per occurrence (up to 10 occurrences per Disability)
You and/or your legal spouse must be between 18 and below 60 years old; coverage ceases at age 70 on expiry of the policy year
Waiting period of thirty (30) days for illness
products.evidence: Relieve your financial burden with Essential Hospital Income insurance!

products.name: ProtectionPlus
products.subtype: adult plan with free cover for up to 3 children (Silver / Gold / Platinum)
products.summary: Personal accident plan with permanent and total disablement cover, daily hospital cash and a bereavement grant.
facts: Platinum Plan: Death $250,000; Permanent and Total Disablement $375,000
Hospital cash benefit $200 daily for a maximum of 50 days (Platinum Plan)
Temporary total disablement: monthly income of $2,400 for up to 2 years (Platinum Plan)
Enrolment: any person aged between 18 years and 65 years
Up to 3 children covered free when you and your spouse enrol at the same time
products.evidence: Protection Plus is a personal accident insurance plan

products.name: PA RecoveryPlus
products.subtype: family plan: adult, child and senior (parents) cover; Silver / Gold / Platinum
products.summary: Personal accident plan with essential, recovery support and lifestyle support benefits, covering up to three generations on one policy.
facts: Platinum Plan: Accidental death $300,000; Permanent disability $450,000 (per policy year)
Daily hospital income (Platinum): $150 per day up to 365 days
Adult Cover: you and your spouse aged 18 to 65 years old, renewable up to age 75
Child Cover: up to five children aged one month old to 25 years old; Senior Cover: parents and parents-in-law aged 50 to 70, renewable up to age 80
Home Modification for mobility (per lifetime): Silver $5,000, Gold $7,000, Platinum $10,000
products.evidence: PA Recovery Plus insurance provides 360 protection

products.name: PA PrimePlus (Series II)
products.subtype: high sum-insured accidental death / permanent disability (Silver / Gold)
products.summary: Annually renewable personal accident plan paying a lump sum on accidental death or permanent disability, with optional medical expenses cover.
facts: Accidental death / permanent disability (main insured 18 to 65): Silver $500,000, Gold $1,000,000
New applications aged between 18 and 65 years old; renewable up to 75 years old
Spouse (optional) at 50% of the main insured's sum insured; free child cover for unlimited number of children when both parents are insured in the same policy
Adventurous activities cover pays 50% of sums insured
Optional medical expenses for injury (per accident, 18 to 65): Silver $5,000, Gold $7,500
products.evidence: PA Prime Plus (Series II) is a personal accident insurance plan that renews annually

products.name: DentiPlus
products.summary: Dental insurance with cashless treatment at network clinics and immediate cover with no medical questionnaire.
facts: Up to 100% coverage for emergency dental, preventive, and dental radiology services
Up to 90% coverage for tooth fillings and extraction
Up to 80% coverage for root canal treatment
Insured person aged between eighteen (18) years old and below sixty (60) years old at commencement, usual country of residence Singapore
products.evidence: DentiPlus Benefits Select plans to compare

notes: General insurer: no life, endowment, ILP or annuity products on the personal menu (Travel, Motor, Home & Maid, Health & PA, Critical Illnesses, Golf, Pet). Skipped travel, motor, home, maid, golf, pet.
No Integrated Shield Plan or IP rider found. Prestige Healthcare is the only hospitalisation product and its page never mentions MediShield Life or Integrated Shield.
Prestige Healthcare has an optional maternity benefit (Deluxe and Platinum only) but no separate maternity page, so it is not listed under maternity_child.
Premium/discount promotions and 'Corporate Employee Scheme' variants of the same products exist; ignored.
The /personal/ pages are linked from the personal-insurance hub only through JS-rendered cards; they were found via sitemap.xml and the homepage 'Learn more' links.
Essential Hospital Income page offers no brochure, only policy wordings. Page states 'up to $400' daily cash on the Premier plan, matching the table.
